title: First United Bank & Trust Welcomes Gabriel Mulitauaopele to Commercial Relationship Manager Role
summary: Jarrod Furgason, Director of Commercial Services at First United Bank & Trust, is pleased to welcome Gabriel Mulitauaopele as a Commercial Relationship Manager serving Washington and Frederick counties in Maryland and the Eastern Panhandle of West Virginia.
body_markdown:
Jarrod Furgason, Director of Commercial Services at[First United Bank & Trust](http://mybank.com/) , is pleased to welcome Gabriel Mulitauaopele as a Commercial Relationship Manager serving Washington and Frederick counties in Maryland and the Eastern Panhandle of West Virginia.


In his new role, Mulitauaopele will work directly with business owners and organizations to help them achieve their financial goals. He will provide guidance on lending and banking solutions, build strong customer relationships, and support the continued growth of First United’s commercial banking services throughout the region.


Mulitauaopele is already familiar with First United and its commitment to community banking. He began his journey with the Bank as a commercial banking intern, where he supported client relationship efforts, assisted with strategic projects, and worked alongside commercial banking and credit teams. During his internship, he helped strengthen customer engagement initiatives and gained valuable experience analyzing financial information and supporting lending activities.


A graduate of the University of Maryland, Mulitauaopele earned a Bachelor of Arts in Economics. His studies also included business analytics, statistics, and accounting. While attending the University of Maryland, he was active in the Real Estate Club and Club Golf.


“Gabriel made a strong impression during his time as an intern, and we’re excited to welcome him into this role,” said Furgason. “He brings enthusiasm, a strong work ethic, and a genuine desire to help our customers succeed. We’re excited to see what he brings to the table as he grows his career with First United and serves businesses across our market.”


Mulitauaopele will be located at the First United Bank & Trust Hagerstown Community Office, and can be reached at301-791-7911 orgmulitauaopele@MyBank.com .


First United Corporation operates one full-service commercial bank, First United Bank & Trust. The Bank has a network of community offices in Garrett, Allegany, Washington, and Frederick counties in Maryland, as well as Mineral, Berkeley, and Monongalia counties in West Virginia. First United’s website can be located at MyBank.com. As of 6/30/2026, the corporation posted assets of $2.1 billion.
